name: swaying-reeds
prompt: Make a row of 12 thin reeds, each 0.04 m square and 0.9 m tall, standing on the ground 0.12 m apart. They sway sideways about 12 degrees every 3 seconds, but not all together: each reed is a little out of step with the others so the row ripples.

name: wave-of-pillars
prompt: Make 8 pillars, each 0.2 m wide and 1 m tall, in a straight line 0.5 m apart. Each pillar rises and falls by 0.3 m every 2 seconds, and a wave of motion travels along the line: every pillar is a quarter of a second behind the one before it.
